statusText: Green - weekend halt in force, Tail at its structural floor
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is far below the block threshold and no evidence-based danger window applies, because every published hour falls inside the CME weekend halt and no price path can form. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active as always. The reopen at 22:00Z on Sunday sits beyond this window.
headline: A 3.75%-4.00% policy rate, a 10-year near 5% and $100 crude sit out the weekend halt behind a 14.81 VIX, with Tail at its floor
body: Every hour published here falls inside the CME weekend halt. Cash Nasdaq-100 settled Friday at 29,644.17, up 197.17 points or 0.67% from a 29,447.00 previous close, finishing near the top of a 29,371.89-29,647.80 range. The E-mini NQ last printed 29,917.25, up 0.59%, after opening at 29,723.75 and ranging 29,648.00-29,993.25. VIX fell 4.08% to 14.81 and settled at the low of a 14.80-15.63 daily range. Friday was a quadruple-witching expiry, among the largest on record, and it cleared without disorder. The week's anchor was Tuesday's FOMC decision: a unanimous 12-0 vote raising the target range 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, the first increase in more than three years, with a hawkish post-decision tone. H.15 shows the 2-year at 4.67% and the 10-year at 4.94% on 17 September, and Friday reporting placed the 10-year back near 5.01% after a multi-year high earlier in the week; effective fed funds printed 3.88%. Front-month WTI settled at $100.30, down about 1.6%, and Brent at $103.87, a third consecutive decline as physical supply panic eased after Aramco signalled a partial East-West pipeline restart within days and full capacity in roughly six weeks; European refiners were told to expect no allocations next month and Strait of Hormuz shipping risk is unresolved. Friday's tape was dispersed rather than directional: megacaps split four up and four down for a mean change near +0.24%, with Broadcom up 2.97% against Meta down 2.43%, while semiconductors led on Micron +3.92%, Arm +4.04% and AMD +2.70% but with Qualcomm down 5.82%. Over the full week the Nasdaq gained about 0.7% while the S&P slipped 0.2% and the Dow fell 1.7%. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was only partially collected this hour, with the futures and calendar sections unavailable, so futures and calendar evidence here rests on independently verified primary sources. Tail is held at its structural weekend floor because no price path can form: the pathological no-retracement structure that Tail measures has no venue in which to develop. Stress is low and drifts higher only as the stock of unpriced headlines grows against static marks. The genuine sensitivity of this assessment sits beyond its final hour, at the Sunday 22:00Z reopen.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly assessments were published and every one mapped to green. Tail ran 15-19 through the European morning and the U.S. cash session, then fell to 11, 7, 6 and 5 as trading ended and the contract settled, holding 5 across the final six hours. Stress peaked at 51 during the U.S. afternoon and decayed through 44, 33, 28 and 27 into the halt, reaching 21 in the most recent slot. Confidence held between 81 and 88 throughout. Dominant mode rotated from normal through trend-up in the European morning to mixed across the dispersed U.S. session, back briefly to trend-up into the close, then to normal once the weekend halt began.
outlookSummary: All 24 published slots fall inside the weekend halt: cash closed at 20:00Z on Friday, the E-mini printed last near 21:00Z, and CME equity futures do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, about seventeen hours after the final slot here. Tail is held between 5 and 7 across the window, with a gradual lift through Saturday evening and the Sunday small hours that reflects the growing stock of unpriced headlines - principally the Middle East supply file, the rates file and AI-policy sentiment - rather than any observed structure. Stress rises slowly from 21 to 27 on the same reasoning, crossing into the moderate band late on Saturday, and Confidence decays from 80 to 68 as Friday's verified marks age without a refreshing observation. Dominant mode is normal in every slot and the mapped policy state is unchanged throughout. The genuine sensitivity of this assessment sits beyond its final hour, at the reopen, where a gap that extends without a meaningful retracement alongside aligned yields, crude and semiconductors would be the structure that matters; a gap that is absorbed and retraced would be ordinary.
